title: Panel Ghost Interaction Mode
description: When UI interaction starts in a panel, active element stays visible, rest dims to 5% opacity, panel becomes click-through to canvas.
summary: Completed global panel hiding for window and panel interactions. Ghosted controls now resolve to fully hidden opacity even when inline opacity is present; window command chrome, desktop/mobile panel frames, tree gutters, and vertical guides participate in ghost visibility. Only a directly interacted tree row remains active, with its logical parent rows and connecting indentation guides preserved. Added regression coverage for tree ancestry and non-tree controls. Focused Nx tests and lint pass; the full package suite retains six unrelated existing tree-render failures, typecheck retains the package's existing broad error set, and Storybook's Layout preview is blocked by its current empty-root/docgen failure.
